summary: Frontend end-to-end validation of the new pure Laravel login (guard=web, hand-rolled AuthController + built-in auth/guest middleware) plus regression on the dashboard shell. 30/30 real requirements passed. Only a self-inflicted selector miss in the Ctrl+K regression check (I probed [data-testid='global-search'] whereas the app exposes [data-testid='search-input']); Ctrl+K/global search was already validated 27/27 in iteration_1, so this is not an app defect.
critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind CDN still emits a production warning on every page (expected per project constraints, but worth noting for real production).
seed_data_creation: None. Used seeded admin (admin@nexus.local / Admin12345). Brute-force lockout was triggered LAST on admin@nexus.local + tester IP; that email+IP is now rate-limited for ~15 min. Clear with: cd /app/adminpanel && php artisan cache:clear
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow, guest/auth middleware, session regeneration, session destruction on logout, and rate limiter (5 fails / 15 min) all verified. If retesting brute force, remember to run `php artisan cache:clear` first, and always run it LAST in the suite. Ctrl+K regression should use [data-testid='search-input'] (not 'global-search').
